subject: How to center a gvisTable in the main panel?

messages.author: 697b680d95df20fd
messages.subject: How to center a gvisTable in the main panel?
parts:
Hi guys,

I generated a gvisTable in mainpanel and by default the table is aligned to the left. I just wonder how can I center the gvisTable , or at least add some margin at the left?

I tried

                  tags$style(type="text/css",
                             HTML("#summary table: { align: center }")
                  ),
                  htmlOutput("summary"),
                  ......

But it seems that "table" in  HTML("#summary table: { align: center }") is not the right code.

Any suggestion?

Thanks a lot for the help!

Ying

messages.subject: Re: How to center a gvisTable in the main panel?
parts:
No, you don't put the style inside the element you want to affect; you use a CSS selector to indicate what element to effect. #summary>div means, find the HTML tag with the id of "summary", and choose all immediate children with tagname "div".

What's inside the "resumen" that you want to center?

Hi Joe, 

"resumen" makes reference to this gvisTable:

output$resumen <- renderGvis({
      ## Table with enabled paging
      
       date_seq <- seq(input$dates[1], input$dates[2], by = "day")
      
       Ikasa_Adwords <- Ikasa_Adwords %>% 
                         filter(date %in% date_seq)
      
      
      
      Ikasa_Adwords_Resumen <- Ikasa_Adwords %>%
                                summarise(Sesiones = prettyNum(sum(sessions), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = "."),
                                Inversion = prettyNum(sum(ad.cost),big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = "."),
                                Clicks = prettyNum(sum(ad.clicks), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = "."),
                                Impresiones = prettyNum(sum(impressions),big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = "."))
      
    
      
      
      #Ikasa_Adwords_Resumen <- melt(Ikasa_Adwords_Resumen, id.vars = "date")
      
      
      resumen <- gvisTable(Ikasa_Adwords_Resumen)
      resumen
  })
